checklist: mount -t tmpfs none /mnt/t, write + read back, umount: listing and file gone
mount -t fsa none /mnt/f: succeeds in nomedium state; mount lists it with nomedium
ls /mnt/f → empty, rc 0; cat /mnt/f/x and ls /mnt/f/x → No medium found, rc ≠ 0
mount lists both tmpfs and fsa; mount -t fsa filters
mount -t nosuchfs → unknown filesystem type, rc ≠ 0
mount -o ro → write gives Read-only file system
-o maxfile=xyz → bad option (EINVAL); mount over /proc → busy; umount of a plain dir → not mounted
hostfs without a grant hook → refused (harness has no hostfs hook; hostfs connect not covered)
needsNote: Kernel pin 1.17.0 = first release with slicc-kernel#92 process mount/umount2 (MNT_DETACH revocation, nomedium in /proc/mounts, ro enforced at open). The harness page has no hostfs grant hook, so only the hostfs refusal is checked.
